issues.message: Hamilton: X 175.629 outside 200 to 450, Y -386.510 outside -250 to 100, Z 36.231 outside 70 to 400 mm. Review the physical workspace; limits were not changed.
Hamilton extension is 389.683 mm from the arm base; the automatic planner allows 383.000 mm. Teach a closer position or commission the reach limit; it was not relaxed.
Descend was captured at Z278.459, but Grip at Z72.139: 206.320 mm of descent is missing between stages. Record Descend at the final pickup depth before closing the jaws.
The pickup captures include lateral or wrist changes. Record a vertical descent after Align, followed by a stationary grip.
Taught E1 goes from 0.000 to 3.579 mm. Record Descend with the jaws open, then Grip after closing; an opening is not a pickup command.
Home to Hamilton: path outside Y envelope. No motion was sent.
Grip to Hamilton: path outside Y envelope. No motion was sent.

checks.method: Home planner: raise to at least Z300, rotate, translate, then lower; checked IK branch and wrist limits.
checks.next_step: Correct the listed teaching/workspace issues, then check again.
limitations: Station captures do not record the path between them.
IK checks reach and joint continuity, not obstacles or plate clearance.
Saved calibration results are historical; a transfer must calibrate and align again.
A measured E1 endpoint alone does not verify a secure grasp.
Polling is not servo-synchronous. Force/contact and object presence are not recorded.
E1 resets can occur on mode/program changes; a reset is not a verified grasp.
These samples cannot be replayed directly. All proposed stages require review.
